rationale: The bounded change affects product semantics and spans three canonical owners, so it requires a scoped formal delivery path. Compact Delivery is ineligible because the fixture does not show a completed Brownfield Review or stored quick_task context; Verified Change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation for derived paths.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics impact is true, requiring more than an ungated or trivial path.
Three canonical owners and three source paths indicate cross-owner scope unsuitable for verified_change.
Four derived paths exist while deterministic propagation is false.
Baseline cleanliness and deterministic validation reduce risk but do not cure the ownership and propagation failures.
No runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact is供应.
Compact Delivery prerequisites are incomplete: completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not shown
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
